using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit;
using TMPro;

            hapticFeedback.SetActive(true);
            Invoke("DisableHaptics", 0.5f);

    private void DisableHaptics()
    {
        hapticFeedback.SetActive(false);
    }
}
